arguments.sql:
SELECT c.types, COUNT(*) AS language_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS printings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS oracle_ids,
       SUM(c.scryfallOracleId IS NULL OR c.scryfallOracleId = '') AS missing_ids,
       SUM(f.flavorText IS NULL) AS null_texts, SUM(TRIM(f.flavorText) = '') AS blank_texts,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.language) AS languages
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B' AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
GROUP BY c.types

SELECT c.types, COUNT(*) AS language_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS printings,

       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.language) AS languages
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B' AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
GROUP BY c.types

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B'
  AND INSTR(',' || c.types || ',', ',Artifact,') > 0
  AND TRIM(f.flavorText) <> ''
LIMIT 1
